text:
Eli: Anyone seeing weird GPU capacity dips in us-west this morning? prometheus shows nodes at 0 for dcgm_exporter metrics.
Priya: Yep, noticed autoscaler didn't spin new nodes. Grafana shows scrape gaps around 03:12 UTC.
Jorge: I pulled logs from new rust-exporter pod on gpu-spot-07, it's stuck in startup loops:
```
[INFO] starting rust-gpu-exporter v0.9.1
[WARN] init cgroup: failed to read /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes: permission denied
[ERROR] failed to open /dev/nvidia0: resource temporarily unavailable
[INFO] retrying device probe in 5s
```
Emily: Kubelet probes are tiny: startupProbe missing, readiness 5s, liveness 10s. exporter needs ~20-30s on these older nodes because of slow device init + cgroup checks. Pods get restarted before metrics ever show up.
Eli: So prometheus scrapes miss metrics when exporter flaps -> capacity underreported -> autoscaler decided not to scale? our scale logic uses per-node `gpu_present` + `gpu_util` which only exists when exporter is up.
Priya: I also saw a few nodes where the exporter falls back to legacy cgroup paths and hits EACCES on cgroup v2. No OOMs, just CrashLoopBackOffs because readiness never becomes true.
Jorge: Quick mitigation: add a `startupProbe` (60s) and bump readiness initialDelaySeconds to 30, liveness failureThreshold to 10. Longer term: add cgroup v2 detection and fallback path in exporter (I have a patch).
Eli: Can we hotfix the deployment so scrapes stabilize ASAP?
Priya: I can patch the deployment now:
- add startupProbe: httpGet /ready timeout 5s initialDelay 5s period 5s failureThreshold 12
- readiness.initialDelaySeconds: 30
- liveness.failureThreshold: 10
- resources.requests: cpu 100m, memory 64Mi
Would apply in infra namespace.
Emily: Also a monitoring tweak: Prometheus scrape_interval is 15s but our cross-region scrape_offset made gaps align badly for multi-region dashboards. Set scrape_timeout to 10s and add relabel to drop `exporter_unavailable` noisy series for alerts while patching.
Jorge: I'll open the PR for cgroup v2 fallback. Also suggest adding an initContainer that touches /dev/nvidia* to warm the device and avoid the race.
Eli: Sounds good. Priya, go ahead with the patch. Please add a short message to #incidents when you apply. We'll watch autoscaler and grafana.
Priya: Applying now. kubectl patch deploy rust-exporter -n infra --patch "..."
deploy-bot: Patch applied to infra/rust-exporter at 1749876590 by Priya. Rolling update started. :rocket:
Emily: After the rollout scrapes came back within ~90s and autoscaler recomputed capacity. Some nodes still slow, but overall healthy.
Jorge: PR #412 for cgroup-v2 fallback is up, includes unit tests for detection and a small integration job.
Eli: Follow-ups: 1) merge Jorge's fix and release v0.9.2 2) add grafana panel for `exporter_ready{node=~"gpu.*"}` boolean per node 3) put a tiny e2e that simulates slow device init so probes are tuned.
Priya: I'll open a follow-up ticket with runbook steps for similar flapping.
Eli: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
